name: Atlanta
partyWallEvidence: Genuine party walls. 144 deg (SE, BAG ring edge 5, 21.9 m): shared with the NH hotel block at Stadhouderskade 7 (BAG pand adjoins along the whole edge; Commons 'Amsterdam Stadhouderskade 5.jpg' shows the hotel against it, the tower rising from the junction). 330 deg (NW, ring edge 0, 21.9 m): shared with the neighbouring block on the Leidsebosje side (w01-52 shows the grey neighbour against the NW end of the front). Upper parts above the neighbours are plain brick in the Commons view; no openings are claimed there.

surveyed.source: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012080492 outline (RD, 3DBAG LoD0); massing is the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell of that pand (CC BY 4.0) in native east/south metres (scripts/landmarks/atlanta-stadhouderskade-prepare.ts). Storey lines, window axes, oriels, entrance portal, attic and tower slit measured on the rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panorama crop w01-52 at 42.2 px/m and the Commons photograph 'Amsterdam Stadhouderskade 5.jpg' (scripts/landmarks/atlanta-stadhouderskade-inventory.json).

attribution.title: Atlanta, Stadhouderskade 5-6 (office building, F.A. Warners, 1927-1928, attic storey 1955; gemeentelijk monument)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) and BAG outline (CC0): the shop floor with its louvred fascia, the first floor of narrow windows with relief piers, the office storeys with boxed-out transom lights, the two half-round oriels, the bracket course, corner blocks, the ribbed attic and the 1955 glass storey, the granite entrance portal and the tower's glazed slit; read for proportion only from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and Wikimedia Commons photographs (CC BY-SA 3.0, see scripts/landmarks/atlanta-stadhouderskade-inventory.json). No pixels or meshes imported.
